description.summary: displays with no screen, for screen sharing

protocol.description: A client adds a display that has no screen behind it: one that is on the layout like any monitor plugged in, and whose picture the client takes with wlr-screencopy, as a screen sharer sending it to a TV does. It is a head in wlr-output-management, so it can be arranged and resized like the others, and it goes away when the client destroys it or disconnects.

request.name: create
request.description: Adds a WIDTHxHEIGHT display refreshing REFRESH times every thousand seconds (0 for 60 Hz). MAKE and MODEL are what the display is shown as. The display answers with name once it's on, or failed.

description.summary: the displays made through it stay

event.name: name
event.description: The display is on the layout, as the wl_output and output head called NAME.

event.name: failed
event.description: The display wasn't added, or was taken away; the object does nothing more and can be destroyed.
